patch_description: The recommendation: interleave discrete worst-triplet refinement between annealing stages. After each Powell temperature stage in `run_start`, find the argmin triplet, extract its 3 points' 9 barycentric params, and run a cheap Powell optimization on only those 9 variables with a low-temperature softmin. This adds targeted, triplet-aware local moves at low cost, breaking the 0.03 plateau while keeping the global schedule. Also reduce the per-stage iteration budgets slightly to offset added time, and add a final extra polish loop over the incumbent.
